well.name: The Village Well
well.description: Choked with ash and rubble. Cleared and walled anew, its water will let your flask hold one more draught.
restoredLines: The well runs clear again. Your flask can hold one more draught.

storehouse.name: The Storehouse
storehouse.description: A collapsed storehouse. Rebuilt, it will hold what you cannot carry: your pack grows by eight slots.
restoredLines: Shelves and sacks, stacked to the rafters. Your pack has room for eight more.

palisade.name: The Palisade
palisade.description: The village wall lies in splinters. Raised again, it will keep the blight's creatures from rising near the village.
restoredLines: The palisade stands. Nothing of the blight stirs this close to the village now.

lamps.name: The Lamp Posts
lamps.description: Toppled lamp posts along the east road. Set upright and lit, they will hold back the dark.
restoredLines: The lamps burn steady. The road east is lit.

smithy.name: The Smithy
smithy.description: The smith's forge lies cold and broken. With a Kindling to relight it, the smith will return and take your weapons further than the old forge could.
restoredLines: SMITH: The fire's back, and so am I. Bring your blade to the forge.
SMITH: I can take it past what that old anvil managed. Two more tempers, if you've the iron for it.
